evaluation_basis: Inspected frames from ../artifacts/frames_v13, measured shot statistics, audio measurements and composition timing. Audio was not auditioned; sound-bridge judgments remain provisional. SHARED.md was read; ../references/TECHNIQUES.md was not found. Measured ASL is 3.17 s versus reference ASLs of 0.97, 1.27 and 4.5 s. The film has short inserts and sustained holds, but the product section settles into repeated three-second beats.

issues.evidence: Four consecutive three-second panel crops show 'Every change, in one list.', 'The exact box David flagged.', 'And the chart that depends on it.' and 'Each one: accept or reject.' Frames retain nearly identical floating-panel framing.
issues.suggested_action: Combine the chart and controls into one continuous move, retain a readable hold on the flagged box, and shorten the sequence from 12 seconds to approximately 9 seconds.

issues.evidence: Both 00:45 and 00:47.5 samples show the PowerPoint cover 'Board Pack Q3'; the sequence then spends 2.5 seconds on Maya's face before returning to review.
issues.suggested_action: Replace the cover hold with the existing real Slide 2 diff panel and move directly into the flagged change; reduce Maya's reaction to a brief punctuation beat.

issues.evidence: The memo containing '**€74.6m**' and the unchanged table receives 2.2 seconds; the two-deck comparison containing 'Not your deck.' receives 2.25 seconds. Both require locating a discrepancy as well as reading.
issues.suggested_action: Give each discrepancy at least 2.5 seconds of stable visibility, funding the additional time by trimming the later review plateau.

issues.evidence: Measured statistics report only 7.7% of shots under one second. The grind alternates isolated short inserts with 2.2–2.5-second screen holds, repeatedly returning to the same shoulder-and-laptop composition.
issues.suggested_action: Cluster three existing hand, desk and face inserts into one accelerating run, then land on readable screen holds; preserve the workflow order and all message-reading minimums.

issues.evidence: The red ellipse around the stale slide box at 00:25–00:27.5 returns around 'Slide 2 · TextBox 23' at 00:55, but the two targets occupy different positions and scales.
issues.suggested_action: Align the ellipse and amount across the two shots, using a brief reprise of the flagged box followed by a match cut into its real diff row.

issues.evidence: After '10 of 10 changes accepted', the film adds three seconds of the corrected memo, three seconds of dawn and three seconds of David before the six-second end card.
issues.suggested_action: Keep the corrected memo readable for three seconds, shorten dawn to approximately 1.5 seconds and cut David to the completed nod, retaining the end-card hold.
